main_text.head: AD CHRISTIANISS. FRANCIÆ REGEM HENRICVM II.
Gulielmi Rouillij Epistola.
main_text.p: REGES Dij mortales, immortalitatem consequi possunt duabus potissimum rationi-bus, literarum honore, & armorum gloria. Qua duo aeter-nitati paranda officia, uni o-lim Palladi mystice attribu-ta, post paucos, sed maximos Principes Alexandrum, Cæsarem, & Carolum Magnum simul sic præstitit, & ea exercuit felicissima memoria Rex Franciscus pater tuus (ô Rex Christianissime) ut consum-mandam armorum gloriam filio relinquens, literarum honorem ad summum extulerit. Tu vero utrumque sic es amplexus, ut togata militia decus patri aliquatenus concedens, rerum bellicarum victorias, & triumphos persequaris, pari nixu iuxtà, atque successu. Quamobrem cùm huius utriusque laudis memoran-da exempla ad te, supra cæteros omnes Christianos Principes referri debeant: hoc ipsum volumen, quod

page.notes: The woodcut initial R (a figure scene within a frame) is joined to the first word as "REGES". The printed text reads "Dij" and "Qua" as shown. Several words are printed with a long s rendered as a plain s, transcribed as such. The signature "Aa 2" is set at the lower right and its final numeral is read as printed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is not transcribed.
